data_quality_findings: 427 data records, header has 271 columns; rows carry 91 to 151 fields, none longer than the header.
Timestamps: all 427 parse as YYYY.MM.DD_HH.MM.SS, non-decreasing, 1 s resolution; 74 records share the timestamp of the previous record; no exact duplicate rows.
Sampling is irregular: 43 inter-record gaps exceed 10 s (longest 93 s), 39 of them opened by a record with FOREGROUND=false (152 such records).
Level and Qual are numeric in all 427 records; no -201 loss-of-coverage code and no out-of-range RSRP/RSRQ/SINR value.
SNR is '-' in 7 records, all labelled 5G (NR_SS_SINR valid N 214 of 221).
SecondCell_* (LTE anchor) is empty in 1 record labelled 5G (LTE KPIs valid N 426 of 427) and filled in 1 record labelled 4G (not pooled, to avoid double counting).

The 7 5G records with missing SNR duplicate LTE values in Level/Qual; kept in NR_SS_RSRP/RSRQ per schema; excluding them moves the NR_SS_RSRP mean from -99.07 to -99.44 dBm and poor share from 14.03 to 14.49 %.
12 of 25 4G-to-5G label changes show the last 4G record with the Level/Qual of the next 5G record; excluding them moves the LTE_RSRP mean from -92.85 to -92.75 dBm.

Readings are refreshed more slowly than records are written: 44.1 % of consecutive 5G records repeat the same Level/Qual/SNR triple (37.0 % for 4G records, 46.2 % for anchor values); samples are not independent.
GPS: all 427 coordinates are well-formed (Accuracy 1 to 23 m), but 63 records lie in 6 frozen-position runs and are excluded from location statements only.
Speed is consistent with km/h (median difference to GPS-derived speed 0.4 km/h over 229 steps).

No active test was run: Test_Status, PING* and TESTDOWNLINK/TESTUPLINK are empty in all 427 records; throughput and RTT are N/A. DL_bitrate/UL_bitrate are passive counters (non-zero in 114/112 records).
CSI_RSRP/CSI_RSRQ/CSI_SNR and NRSTATE are empty in all records; no NR-ARFCN or NR band field is populated: ARFCN/BAND hold the LTE carrier (equal to SecondCell_ARFCN in 220 of 221 5G records).
LTERSSI is quantised in 2 dB steps (all 206 values odd) and is not above RSRP in 135 of 206 4G records, which is not consistent with a wideband RSSI; not used.
Distance=-1, Bearing=1000, Site_BEARING=1000, AVGSPEED=0, TA=0 or empty, Cellname/IMEI/IMSI empty: placeholders, no site database; not used.
NetworkTypeNum is 13 in all 427 records, including those labelled 5G; the field is not described in the schema note and is not interpreted here.
Events file (79 events) is identical in timestamp, type and details to the EVENT column of the main log (plus one LOG START).

anomaly_candidates.what: Sustained weak NR SS-RSRP/SS-SINR while the LTE anchor is also weak and the serving cell alternates between operator codes 22610 and 22601 (observation; cause not established).
anomaly_candidates.evidence: 44 NR samples: SS-RSRP median -110 dBm, min -117; 21 below -110 dBm; SS-SINR median 0 dB, min -6; anchor RSRP min -114 dBm, anchor SNR min -19 dB (at 2026.10.02_12.19.17); 9 mobility events, 5 between operator codes; from 45.78329N 21.31208E to 45.77728N 21.30673E; Speed 64 -> 8 km/h.

anomaly_candidates.what: NR quality drops after the serving cell changes to 22601 node 947902 cell 7; label then falls back to 4G for 5 records and returns to 5G (observation).
anomaly_candidates.evidence: 14 NR samples: SS-RSRP min -115 dBm (6 below -110), SS-SINR min -6 dB (10 below 0); anchor RSRP min -109 dBm; passive UL_bitrate up to 326 kbps; from 45.76207N 21.24551E to 45.76133N 21.24332E.

anomaly_candidates.what: Records labelled 5G with missing SNR whose Level/Qual duplicate LTE values (label/field race at the 5G-to-4G label change); their Level/Qual are probably LTE, not NR (hypothesis).
anomaly_candidates.evidence: 7 records with SNR='-'; in 6 Level==SecondCell_RSRP and Qual==SecondCell_RSRQ; in the remaining 1 SecondCell is empty and Level/Qual equal the next 4G record; no other 5G record has both equalities (6 in total).

anomaly_candidates.what: Last 4G-labelled record before a 5G label already carries the Level/Qual of the following 5G record (possible NR values under a 4G label, or stale LTE values under a 5G label; undecidable from the log).
anomaly_candidates.evidence: 12 of 25 4G-to-5G label changes; one 4G record (2026.10.02_12.18.27) even has SecondCell_* filled.

anomaly_candidates.what: GPS position frozen while cell changes continue; fix resumes with a jump that implies an impossible speed.
anomaly_candidates.evidence: held 398 s then 3418 m in 60 s = 205 km/h; held 112 s then 1072 m in 5 s = 772 km/h; held 21 s then 278 m in 11 s = 91 km/h; held 49 s then 360 m in 14 s = 92 km/h; held 271 s then 1054 m in 35 s = 108 km/h; held 189 s then 732 m in 18 s = 146 km/h; 63 records flagged; FOREGROUND=false in 60 of them.

anomaly_candidates.what: Serving-cell operator code alternates between 22610 and 22601 although Operatorname is always 'orange'.
anomaly_candidates.evidence: 22610 in 224 records, 22601 in 203; 36 of 79 mobility events change the operator code; 28 immediate A-B-A returns, 18 within 10 s.

anomaly_candidates.what: Very low LTE RSRP (including the log minimum) while LTERSSI is at its log maximum and SNR is positive: internally inconsistent reading, candidate stale or mis-reported field (position frozen at the time).
anomaly_candidates.evidence: Level -116 dBm, LTERSSI -59 dBm, SNR 8.0 dB, node 82908 cell 5; Level -121 dBm, LTERSSI -59 dBm, SNR 8.0 dB, node 81289 cell 5
